title: Advance-Booking Credit for Alignment Services & Plans Visits
content:
Alignment Services & Plans rewards booking ahead: an advance-booking credit is taken off the labor charged on the open work order of an alignment plan. It is read from the latest appointment booked on the plan for the visit's date — the date that booking was made. The credit is worked out on its own and taken off the labor charged, which is rounded to the nearest cent and never falls below 0.00.

| Latest appointment booked on the plan for the visit's date | Credit |
|---|---|
| Booked at least 2 calendar days before the visit | 5.00 |
| Booked fewer than 2 calendar days before the visit (including on the visit date) | 2.00 |
| No appointment booked on the plan for that date | 0.00 |

### Basis Q&A
**Which booking counts when the appointment was moved?** The latest appointment booked on the plan for the visit's date; an earlier booking for a different date does not count.

**Hypothetical:** a visit on a Friday whose appointment for that Friday was booked on the Wednesday is 2 days ahead, so 5.00; booked on the Thursday, it is 1 day ahead, so 2.00; a drive-in visit with no appointment for that date receives 0.00.
